intro: Slack for corporate travel planners on Mac helps you manage complex itineraries and stakeholder communication. You can use Lazur to stay on top of your messages and tasks while you work on your Mac.
tldr: Use Command K to jump between travel project channels.
Set your status in Slack to show when you are booking flights.

stats.label: Travel managers who source hotels and venues

blocks.text: Corporate travel planners deal with high volumes of data. You might be coordinating hotel blocks for a conference while updating a traveler on their flight changes. Slack is where much of this coordination happens. It is easy to lose track of a specific request in a busy channel.

Start by using the Quick Switcher. Press Command plus K to open it. Type the name of a channel or a person to jump there instantly. This saves you from scrolling through your sidebar. If you need to find a message, use the search bar. Press Command plus G to search globally. Use modifiers like from: or in: to narrow your results.

You spend a lot of time on administrative tasks. Keeping your Slack organized is a requirement. Use threads for every conversation. This keeps the main channel clean. If you need to reply to a specific point, hover over the message and click the speech bubble icon. It keeps your team focused on the right details.

items: Use Command plus / to see all available keyboard shortcuts.
Press Shift plus Enter to add a line break to your message.
Use Command plus B to bold important travel dates.
Clear your cache if the app behaves strangely by going to Help, then Troubleshooting, then Clear Cache and Restart.

blocks.text: How to use Lazur with Slack on Mac

Lazur works as a voice assistant for your Mac. When you are in Slack, you can hold the Option plus Command keys to ask about anything on your screen. If you are looking at a long message from a traveler, ask Lazur to summarize it. It will read the answer out loud.

If you are struggling to find a specific setting in Slack, ask Lazur where it is. It will circle the button on your screen. This is helpful when you are diving into deep preferences. You can also use Lazur to set reminders for when you need to follow up on a booking.

Travel planners often face interruptions. If you need to focus on a complex itinerary, pause your notifications. Go to your profile menu and set a status or use the Do Not Disturb feature. This lets you work without the constant ping of new messages. You can also mute channels that are not urgent.

Remember that your Slack experience depends on the version you use. Ensure you are on macOS 14 or higher to keep the app running well. Slack updates its requirements twice a year. Check your version number in the Slack menu to stay current.

Many planners make the mistake of replying to a thread in the main channel. This creates noise for everyone else. Always check if you are typing in the thread view. Another common error is not using search modifiers. Searching for a keyword without a modifier returns too many results. Use has:link or has:file to find documents quickly.

Do not let your app become cluttered. If a project is finished, archive the channel. It keeps your workspace clean. If you are working with external partners, use Slack Connect. It allows you to share channels safely without leaving your own workspace.

faq.question: How do I find a message in Slack quickly?
faq.answer: Use the search bar by pressing Command plus G. Use modifiers like from:username or in:channelname to filter results.

faq.question: Can Lazur help me navigate Slack?
faq.answer: Yes. Hold Option plus Command and ask where a setting is. Lazur will circle the button or menu item on your screen.

faq.question: What is the best way to keep my team updated?
faq.answer: Use threads for specific travel requests. This keeps the main channel focused on high-level updates.

faq.question: How do I keep Slack running smoothly on my Mac?
faq.answer: Clear your cache by going to Help, then Troubleshooting, then Clear Cache and Restart.
